notes: Berlin Open Data: Kriminalitätsatlas Berlin (Polizei Berlin, CC BY-SA): one Excel workbook with case numbers (Fallzahlen) and frequency figures (Häufigkeitszahl, cases per 100,000 residents) by Bezirk and Bezirksregion, 17 offence categories, yearly since 2016. The module reads the workbook link from this page when the direct URL below fails.
Direct link of the workbook as published in 2026 (its name carries the years: update it when a new edition appears, or leave it and let the page scrape find it).

Geoportal Berlin (CC BY 3.0 DE): LOR Bezirksregionen 2021 boundaries as GeoJSON (143 features; fields bzr_id, bzr_name, bez; layer name checked against the service capabilities on 2026-11-10). Change the layer name if the service renames it (run berlin_inspect()).
